notes: Derivability likely: 'Pelé and Maradona were from different countries' is rarely stated in those words, but follows from their nationalities (premises), which are usually written side by side ('Brazil's Pelé and Argentina's Maradona'), so the contrast is close to stated; hence likely rather than very_likely. Symmetry and transitivity (with the bridge in the prompt) are forced; only which country gives way is open. A third world, both from some other country, is also consistent but gives no concrete answers, so it is left out.
